description: These runtime classes represent closures, built-ins, return control flow, and interpreter errors.

steps.description: The interpreter imports its AST, environment, typing, and dataclass dependencies.
Closure records parameter names, a body, and the environment captured when it is created.
BuiltinFn records a built-in name and callable, with a readable representation.
ReturnSignal carries a returned value through the call stack.
RuntimeError_ formats runtime error messages with a Mini-specific prefix.

title: Define interpreter runtime values
